extraction.Name: Phoebe Bordeaux (Dec'd); deponent David Whiting
extraction.Recorded patent: It was sent to the Farmer at Okreek and I took it home to her in 1917 the best I remember
extraction.NOTES: Phoebe Bordeaux is deceased; deponent David Whiting, age 42, is her former husband. She left four children, the oldest of which is 18; David Whiting supports them. She sold the land for $25.00 per acre, received in cash. She signed a receipt for the patent. Deponent states she was satisfied with the sale so far as he knows. Patent/allotment reference: Dav/ (6 45Z. Notary: W. Gross, commission expires 4-28-32. Sworn May 7, 1929.
